# Release handoff (paste into the existing PR)

- Repository / PR / release operator:
- Full reviewed head SHA / latest check run URLs:
- Required checks and review decision verified at this head:
- Scope: internal-only / preview / production / local-only / native release:
- Preview URL and journey tested, or intentional skip reason:
- Security, private-data and migration review; unresolved blockers:
- Owner release authorization:
- Previous known-good deployment/commit and rollback plan:
- Merge SHA and time:
- Production deployment ID / target / source SHA / alias:
- Smoke checks and observed results (including protected access if applicable):
- Result: prepared / reviewed / merged / deployed / verified / intentionally skipped / blocked:

Recheck after every head change. CI success alone is not proof of release. Never include credential values or private source records in this handoff.
